notes: README has no in-repo setup steps: it defers to the external guide https://dub.co/docs/local-development (README.md:62), which could not be read, so steps are reconstructed from apps/web/.env.example, apps/web/docker-compose.yml, package scripts and CI. Package manager pnpm (pnpm-lock.yaml, packageManager pnpm@9.15.9). Node: README 'Recommended Versions' says node v23.11.0 / pnpm 9.15.9 (README.md:65-70) but CI runs Node 20, so 20 is recorded as the floor. Root 'pnpm dev' = turbo dev, which also runs tsup --watch for @dub/utils and @dub/ui and the react-email preview (packages/email, port 3333); the web dev script (apps/web) runs prisma generate itself, then next dev --turbopack --port 8888, so no separate prisma:generate step. workspace-build may be self-healing when using root turbo dev (tsup --watch builds dist), but is required when starting apps/web alone; CI builds utils explicitly. Env vars needing real values: NEXTAUTH_SECRET, CRON_SECRET, ENCRYPTION_KEY, UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL/TOKEN, QSTASH_TOKEN/QSTASH_CURRENT_SIGNING_KEY/QSTASH_NEXT_SIGNING_KEY, TINYBIRD_API_KEY (+TINYBIRD_API_URL), TEAM_ID_VERCEL/VERCEL_API_KEY and RESEND_API_KEY are listed as required; DATABASE_URL, PLANETSCALE_DATABASE_URL and SMTP_* have working local defaults. 'redis' is Upstash Redis over REST (hosted; CI substitutes redis:7 + serverless-redis-http on 8079); 'tinybird' is Tinybird cloud or tinybird-local (CI). QStash (Upstash) is also marked required; CI runs a local qstash-cli dev server. The PlanetScale HTTP simulator (ps-http-sim) is part of the compose stack alongside MySQL. mailhog is recorded as mailpit.
